summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the filing of updated technical reports for its Gaocheng silver-lead-zinc mine in China and an amended technical report for its Kyrgyzstan gold projects. The filings are routine regulatory updates under NI 43-101, correcting a typographical error without changing resource estimates. No material differences were noted from prior disclosures. This is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No deal terms, stakeholder changes, or structural events are present.
